recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7998 unless FHIR-I separately chooses to revise composite search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-7998 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search clarification from the 2015May ballot asking the Composite Search Parameters section to follow the surrounding pattern where the first sentence defines the parameter type.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 6474. Git commit ec36f3a6f1ac25a85aedff8150fffa71822c8103, imported from that revision, changed source/search.html from the old resource-intersection opening to a composite-definition opening.
additional_context: The search page was later reorganized by FHIR-33158 and typo-fixed by FHIR-41550. Those later final issues refined the sentence to the current wording while preserving FHIR-7998's requested first-sentence definition pattern. Direct community searches found no conflicting FHIR-7998 discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/search.html already says that composite search parameters allow joining multiple elements into distinct single values with '$'.
